Not sure. We might need to call estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage after getting distance. So steps:

1. Call estimate_distance with cityA="San Francisco" or "SF"? The user said "舊金山" which is Chinese for San Francisco. So cityA: "San Francisco". cityB: "Rivermist". Use function estimate_distance.

2. Then call estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage with distance returned.
